description: This file defines the WrappedException class used within the Orleans runtime for error reporting and exception handling, including serialization support and rethrowing logic.

classes.name: WrappedException
classes.description: A custom exception class used by Orleans runtime to wrap and rethrow exceptions with additional context and serialization support.

methods.name: WrappedException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message.

methods.name: WrappedException
methods.description: Obsolete constructor for deserialization, initializing from SerializationInfo.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Serializes the exception data, including the original exception type.

methods.name: CreateAndRethrow
methods.description: Creates a WrappedException from an existing exception and rethrows it, preserving the stack trace.

methods.name: CreateFromException
methods.description: Creates a WrappedException instance from a given exception, capturing its type and message.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the WrappedException, including its original type and message.
